entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
Support.
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hi David. I need to process a return for a VeloBand Cadence Sensor I bought. I have my order number if you need it.
Certainly, I can help with that. Could I get that order number please?
Yes, it's VF886-0115.
Got it. One moment... Okay, I see the order here. It looks like it was delivered on December 15th, which was 24 days ago.
Right, and I know I'm past the 10-day window I saw online, but there's a reason for that. I actually tried to return it about nine days after I got it, but I ran into a major website error.
I see. Can you tell me more about that? What specifically was the issue?

The entire returns portal was just not working. It seemed like the whole system was down. I kept trying to generate a label but I couldn't print anything. I even took a screenshot of the error page because I figured I might need it.
I understand, and I appreciate you keeping a record of that. Let me just pull up the official return policy for the VeloBand... one moment.
Ah, okay. Actually, you have nothing to worry about. The policy I have here states a 90-day return window for this item.
Ninety days? Really? I could have sworn the product page said something much shorter. Are you sure?

Yes, I'm looking right at our knowledge base. It's a 90-day return policy for items in original condition. So, at 24 days, you are well within the timeframe. We can get this processed for you right now.
Wow, okay. That's a lot easier than I expected. I was prepared to negotiate for some store credit or something. This is great news.

Not a problem at all, happy to clear that up for you. I've just initiated the return. You should receive an email with the pre-paid shipping label within the next five minutes. Just pack it up and drop it at any post office.
Perfect. Thanks so much for your help, David.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today for VeloFit?
Nope, that's everything.
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
